title: SelCal: selection-aware calibration of scanned-lag dependence tests

creators.name: Liang, Bingbing
creators.affiliation: School of AI Engineering, Guangzhou College of Technology and Business

description:
SelCal tests lagged dependence between two time series when the lag is chosen by scanning a pre-declared set of candidate lags. It repeats the complete lag search inside every circular-shift surrogate, can enumerate the whole circular group exactly (null circular_shift_exact_v1), refuses plans whose smallest attainable p-value exceeds alpha (with a circular null and L searched lags the exact p-value cannot fall below L/n), and keeps verifiable, replayable records. Command-line workflow: selcal validate, run, verify --replay, report.

This archive contains the source code, tests, documentation, examples, and a reproduction package for the accompanying SoftwareX manuscript (frozen protocols, analysis scripts and results of the simulation studies, the IDTxl comparison, the guard survey, and a re-analysis of a published dengue-climate correlation using the original authors' CC BY 4.0 data). The method credited is the tailored-lag circular-shift test (Cannistra et al., eLife 2025; Yuan and Shou, PLoS Biology 2024).
